source_semantics.identity: The canonical Guid job id identifies one execution-center job. The owner-scoped overload requires a non-empty owner identity.
source_semantics.selection: Cancel mutates only ExecutionMode.Tracked jobs in Waiting, Running, or Paused state; missing, wrong-owner, External, or already-terminal jobs are no-ops.
source_semantics.terminal_transition: A qualifying job becomes Cancelled and CompletedAtUtc is set while progress, processed-item counters, payload, and prior error fields are otherwise left unchanged.
source_semantics.activity: Exactly one Warning activity with the canonical message 'Job cancelled by user.' is appended only when the cancellation transition succeeds.

laravel_adaptation.ledger_mapping: The canonical job Guid maps to operation_executions.correlation_id, the existing job_id already exposed by the Laravel Execution Center adaptation; no second execution ledger is introduced.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_owner_scope: The active TenantContext supplies tenant identity; operations.manage is authorized server-side; the active membership user must equal ownerUserId; lookup and update repeat tenant_id, correlation_id, requested_by_user_id and allowed-state predicates inside one row-locked transaction.
laravel_adaptation.tracked_mode_mapping: Canonical ExecutionMode.Tracked is preserved in operation_executions.payload.execution_mode and is required before cancellation; External jobs remain owned by the separate external lifecycle operations.
laravel_adaptation.state_mapping: Canonical Waiting/Running/Paused/Cancelled map to queued/running/paused/cancelled. Successful cancellation sets completed_at and updated_at without manufacturing progress or modifying the execution payload.
laravel_adaptation.safety_boundary: The Laravel control plane's existing safe_to_cancel=false marker is treated as a fail-closed narrowing: a direct service call cannot cancel work explicitly marked unsafe even if its status would otherwise be eligible.
laravel_adaptation.activity_mapping: A successful transition writes exactly one warning operation_log with message 'Job cancelled by user.', source ExecutionCenterService.Cancel, operation ID AIMW-AUTO-DBF5562324, and owner provenance; repeated or ineligible cancellation writes no activity.

proofs: exact canonical service/domain/source/member and operation ID AIMW-AUTO-DBF5562324
canonical Guid job identity is preserved through correlation_id/job_id rather than an internal numeric row id
owned Tracked queued, running, and paused jobs transition to cancelled and receive completed_at
progress and payload are preserved and no runtime work or progress is manufactured
exactly one canonical Warning cancellation activity is created and repeated cancellation cannot append another
External, already-terminal, and safe_to_cancel=false jobs fail closed without activity
wrong owner and missing operations.manage authorization fail closed
foreign-tenant job/log rows are absent from the active tenant view and the authoritative foreign row remains unchanged
missing TenantContext and invalid typed identity fail closed before persistence
acceptance.external_runtime: No live WordPress/provider/email/payment/DNS/production/manual evidence is required because Cancel changes only the tenant-local tracked execution control plane and does not itself execute external work.
